docDesc.zh: 逐条列出会离开本机的路径：本地 AI 不出机器，模型下载只发一次公开文件请求，云端走你自己的 Key，属地优先离线解析，更新检查只发版本号与清单哈希，表单邮箱只在你主动提交时。
docDesc.en: Every path that can leave your machine, row by row: local AI stays put, a model download asks only for a public file, cloud runs on your own key, location resolution is offline first, the update check sends version numbers and manifest hashes, and the form sends email only when you submit.

title.zh: 会离开本机的，只有下面这几条
title.en: Only these few things can leave your machine

sub.zh: 闭源分发要靠可验证的承诺建立信任，所以这里不写形容词，只写路径、内容与默认状态。
sub.en: Closed-source distribution earns trust with verifiable promises, so this lists paths, payloads and defaults — not adjectives.

1b.zh: 不出本机——识别、整理、嵌入、问答都在本地完成。
1b.en: Nothing — recognition, organizing, embedding and Q&A run locally.

2b.zh: 只有那次请求的正文与追问上下文，走你自己填的 Key、你自己的账户。
2b.en: Just that request's text and follow-up context, through the key you entered and your own account.

2s.zh: 你填入 Key 并主动发起时
2s.en: when you add a key and ask

3b.zh: 优先用本地 IP 数据包离线解析；未命中才联网，且只发 IP，不发任何内容。
3b.en: An offline IP pack is tried first; only a miss goes online, and it sends the IP — never your content.

4b.zh: 当前版本号与资源清单的哈希，用于比对是否有新发布物；不含你的任何内容。
4b.en: The current version number and resource manifest hashes, used to check for new releases. None of your content.

5b.zh: 你在表单里填的邮箱，和那句「现在最挡着你的一件事」。
5b.en: The email you submit, plus the one line about what blocks you most.

6b.zh: 只有一条对公开模型文件的请求，来源是 Hugging Face 或它的国内镜像；请求里不含你的任何内容。
6b.en: A request for one public model file, from Hugging Face or its China mirror — it carries none of your content.

6s.zh: 你下载模型时，或功能首次用到缺失的模型
6s.en: when you download a model, or a feature first needs one that's missing

m1.zh: 邮箱只用于内测通知，不用于营销，不共享给第三方；可随时退订或要求删除。
m1.en: Emails are used for beta notices only — no marketing, no third-party sharing, unsubscribe or request deletion anytime.

m2.zh: 不卖数据、不投广告、不做行为画像。
m2.en: No selling data, no ads, no behavioural profiling.

m3.zh: 数据库与索引是可删除、可重建的派生数据，用户内容的真源始终是你目录里的 Markdown 文件。
m3.en: The database and indexes are derived data you can delete and rebuild; the source of truth for your content stays the Markdown files in your folder.

t2.zh: 这份清单之外的三件事
t2.en: Three things this list does not include

n1.zh: 这个站点是纯静态页面：不加载第三方脚本、不种 cookie、没有分析与广告，字体用系统字体栈，因此打开它不会向任何内容网络发请求。
n1.en: This site is plain static HTML: no third-party scripts, no cookies, no analytics or ads, and system fonts — opening it sends no request to any content network.

n2.zh: 应用没有行为追踪：不采集使用统计，也不上传崩溃日志。会主动联网的就是上面那张表里的几条，没有别的路径。
n2.en: The app does no usage tracking: no analytics events, no crash uploads. What reaches out is the rows in the table above — there is no other path.

n3.zh: 表单这一版还没有接通收件服务：你现在填的邮箱不会离开浏览器。等收件通道上线，本页会同步改口，不会悄悄开始收集。
n3.en: The form has no receiving service wired up yet: the email you type stays in your browser. When collection goes live, this page gets updated first — it will not start quietly.

d1.zh: 内测通知邮件都带退订入口；也可以直接来信要求删除，说明里给出邮箱即可，我们不核对身份之外的任何信息。
d1.en: Every beta notice carries an unsubscribe link. You can also write to us asking for deletion — the address alone is enough, we don't ask for anything beyond it.

d2.zh: 收件通道上线前，上面这条针对的是「将来会存到的数据」；现在提交不会产生任何记录。
d2.en: Until collection goes live, the sentence above describes data that would be stored; submitting today creates no record at all.

v1.zh: 每条路径都对应一次可复现的验证：断开网络启动应用，还能出网的只剩这张表里列到的那几条。
v1.en: Each row maps to something you can reproduce: start the app offline, and the only things that still reach the network are the rows listed here.

v2.zh: 写得不对就是缺陷。发现与本页不符的行为，请在发布仓库提出来。
v2.en: A wrong claim here is a defect. If you find behaviour that contradicts this page, please report it in the releases repository.

stamp.zh: 本页与站点同批构建发布，所述行为以最新发布版本为准。
stamp.en: This page is built and published with the site; the behaviour it describes is that of the latest release.
